# Occupation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Occupation`](gmeow-Occupation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Occupation>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)

A kind of work or profession, such as those classified by ESCO, SOC, or O*NET. Classifications are carried as open code values ([`gmeow:occupationClassification`](../properties/gmeow-occupationClassification.md)), never as OWL subclasses ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
